reason: Vocational education science (Berufspaedagogik) is not taught in any EMI module; timetable subject T113 Grundlagen der Berufspaedagogik und Didaktik names the topic
E032 Data Analytics covers EDA/cleaning and E173 Stochastik the estimation/tests, but regression with regularisation, cross-validation, PCA/SVD and bootstrap (about half) are missing
E173 Stochastik teaches probability, random variables, distributions, expectation/variance and inferential statistics (estimation, hypothesis tests) as the row
No EMI module teaches numerical field simulation (FDM, FEM, BEM, numerical linear algebra); E120/E116 mathematics are general and E051 only basic circuit theory
Lab practice of designing and characterising electronic circuits is the Praktikum part of E046/E047 Elektronische Bauelemente und Schaltungstechnik 1/2; thin description of the underlying lecture
Cost accounting and controlling appear only as list items (internes Rechnungswesen, Controlling) in E019 Betriebswirtschaftliche Grundlagen; no module has it as main topic
E130 Mobile & Ubiquitous Computing teaches Android/mobile software, IoT devices (Arduino, ESP32, RPi), RFID/NFC, sensors and IoT protocols as the row
E117 Mathematik 2 (Diskrete Mathematik) includes graphs and graph-theoretic algorithms but only as one part; a full graph-theory module (matchings, colourings, flows) is not covered
E091 Informationssicherheit covers threat models and ISO 27001 security management, but not risk frameworks (ISO 27005, NIST, FAIR), quantitative risk assessment and risk treatment
E125 Medienlehre und Mediengestaltung covers film design categories and basics of media studies/communication science, but not narrative film analysis and media history
E102 KI Projekt Gaming is a team project implementing and presenting AI methods; the row is a generic small AI project
E019 Betriebswirtschaftliche Grundlagen covers legal form, organisation, personnel, innovation, production, marketing, accounting, investment and finance; entrepreneurship part is missing
E051 Elektrotechnik 3 teaches two-port theory and E082 Hochfrequenztechnik line behaviour, matching and reflection at HF; Smith chart and HF two-port measurement partly missing
E080 Grundlagen elektrischer Maschinen und Antriebe teaches construction and operation of DC and three-phase (synchronous/asynchronous) machines as the row
Clinical study design, multiple testing, survival data, ROC and sample-size planning are not in any EMI module; E173 Stochastik is only general statistics
E044 Elektrische Energietechnik covers equipment for transmission/distribution and networks, but not planning of LV/HV installations, switchgear and surge arresters

FPGA/VHDL design of complex logic and HW/SW co-design goes beyond the VHDL/FPGA introduction in E040 Digitaltechnik and microcontroller E053 Embedded Systems; T061 Digitaler Systementwurf names the topic
E166 Software Engineering 1 (team process, version control, requirements) and E167 Software Engineering 2 (Scrum, user stories, CI, unit tests, quality) cover it; MongoDB/JSON part missing
E171 Speicherprogrammierbare Steuerungen covers design of sequence controls, but not discrete-event theory (automata, Petri nets, observation, diagnosis); E012 is process instrumentation
E045 Elektrische Messtechnik covers measurement errors, instruments, oscilloscopes, bridges, frequency behaviour and lab; the sensors section of the row is missing
